title: Phase-I of DHTI’s first international capacity-building programme for officers of Fiji’s Ministry of Defence & Veteran Affairs concludes at Suva
body_text: The first phase of the maiden ‘Global Leadership Programme in Defence Governance and Public Administration for Emerging Leaders’ by the Defence Headquarters Training Institute (DHTI), Ministry of Defence, for the officers of the Ministry of Defence and Veteran Affairs, Fiji, concluded at Lami, Suva on November 27, 2026. The programme covered facets of good governance, defence procurement, ethics in governance, talent management & capacity building, administrative law, citizen centric governance, modernisation of the audit framework in defence, AI for digital transformation, purpose-driven leadership, strategic communication and emotional intelligence for leaders in the defence sector. The valedictory ceremony of the nearly two-week-long programme was graced by Acting Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Defence & Veteran Affairs, Fiji, Mr Eroni Rokisi and Second Secretary (Political & Head of Chancery), High Commission of India in Fiji, Shri Ranjeet Kumar alongside DHTI faculty & participating officials. Addressing the gathering, Mr Rokisi commended the team of DHTI for delivering an impactful curriculum that brought about a paradigm shift in participants' capabilities and outlook across administration, transparency and accountability, financial management, behavioural and leadership skills, cyber security, and artificial intelligence. The second phase of training is scheduled to take place in New Delhi for two weeks in the first quarter of 2027. The programme has added another milestone to DHTI’s commitment to strengthening capacity building for defence personnel. SR/Savvy
